headline: Rumors of a sale of the Città di Pavia care institute: what we know - La Provincia Pavese
summary: The San Donato Group is reportedly negotiating to acquire four care centres in Lombardy. Workers' unions have raised concerns about the reported talks.
why: San Donato Group is a private Italian healthcare provider, and such deals reshape ownership and capacity in the regional care market.
